mapper.select: select t2.USER_NAME as userName, t2.USER_REALNAME as userRealName, t2.DEPT_NAME as deptName, '主动授权' as authSource, '主动授权-用户' as authSourceDetail, DATE_FORMAT(t1.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as authBeginDate, '2099-12-31' as authEndDate, 0 as isCanDelete from ssm_data_auth_dataset_ctg t1 inner join bi_portal.hr_employee t2 on t1.owner_id = t2.USER_NAME where item_value = #{itemValue} and owner_type = 'User' union all select t2.USER_NAME as userName, t2.USER_REALNAME as userRealName, t2.DEPT_NAME as deptName, '主动授权' as authSourceDetail, concat('主动授权-部门-', t3.dept_path_name) as authSource, DATE_FORMAT(t1.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as authBeginDate, '2099-12-31' as authEndDate, 0 as isCanDelete from ssm_data_auth_dataset_ctg t1 inner join bi_portal.hr_employee t2 ON CONCAT(t2.dept_id, '/') LIKE CONCAT('%', t1.owner_id, '/%') inner join bi_portal.sys_dept t3 on t1.owner_id = t3.dept_id where item_value = #{itemValue} and t1.owner_type = 'Dept'
